approved_reference.voice_strategy: Generate new Lucas French dialogue with the approved synthetic Lucas voice direction and natural connected French phrasing. Voice changes require separate explicit approval.
approved_reference.eyes: approved green-hazel / gray-green olive with subtle amber-brown center and darker limbal rim
approved_reference.note: The V7 black-shirt clip defines validated visual quality, Lucas identity and true front-camera grammar. It does not define permanent wardrobe, location or lighting.

camera_contract.semantic: The viewer is the smartphone front-facing camera Lucas is using for the video call.
camera_contract.framing: head, shoulders and upper torso at natural arm-length distance
reject_if: Lucas is filmed holding a phone
the image looks like a portrait or cinematic shot
camera uses dolly, zoom, cinematic pan or coverage

ai_role: interpret current save state and call context
decide Lucas intent and next conversational beat
select only approved media matching context
keep conversation state coherent across turns
outgoing_call: check Lucas canonical availability and presence
ring or decline naturally depending on context
if answered choose an approved opening matching place, time, mood and relationship state
continue through AI-selected conversational beats and player choices
incoming_call: Lucas may call only when story and presence rules allow it
opening and follow-up depend on current context rather than a fixed script
interaction.runtime_generation_rule: Never make the player wait for heavy video generation during a live call. Heavy media is generated and approved upstream; runtime AI handles meaning, branching, selection and continuity.
interaction.surprise_rule: The player must never be shown the hidden media catalog, branch map or future call possibilities.

must_keep: real visio framing rather than cinematic camera grammar

rules: Only explicitly approved visio clips may be shown live.
Generated listening, speaking, reaction and thinking clips are candidates until approval.
Lucas identity and movement selection must consult config/lucas-reference-bank.json.
For every Lucas visio candidate, bind the approved V7 front-camera grammar plus appropriate identity, movement and performance references from the Lucas bank.
Do not optimize lip sync by altering voice timing; synchronize visuals around the approved voice performance instead.
Never use playback-rate warping or random seeking to fake lip synchronization.
Never use pasted-mouth or post-hoc lip replacement as the primary Lucas visio method.
If an approved state clip is missing, show a neutral call state without unapproved video rather than any candidate fallback.
Lucas identity must come from the locked Lucas canon pack, reference bank and approved Lucas visio face reference.
Every visio must adapt to current gameplay context and must not be a visually identical loop reused for every call.
The approved V7 black-shirt sample defines quality, identity and front-camera grammar, not permanent wardrobe or permanent location.
Reject any candidate that is not unmistakably a true phone-front-camera video call before presenting it for human approval.
Visio output must remain natural, photorealistic and free of identity drift.
